Gold.note: Strong central bank demand and macroeconomic rate cut expectations.

Silver.note: High beta to gold with robust industrial and solar panel demand.

Copper.note: Tight smelter treatment charges and structural electrification demand.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit amid renewed global nuclear buildout.

Lithium.note: Near-term market oversupply and slowing electric vehicle growth.

Nickel.note: Persistent Indonesian supply surplus and LFP battery substitution.

Zinc.note: Smelter feed shortages and mine closures supporting tight balances.

Iron Ore.note: Ongoing weakness in Chinese property sector dampening steel demand.

Coal.note: Ample seaborne supply and normalized thermal prices.

Rare Earths.note: Oversupply from increased Chinese domestic production quotas.

Manganese.note: Balanced market with offsetting steel demand and logistics constraints.

PGM.note: Declining internal combustion engine demand offsetting hydrogen potential.

Potash.note: Stabilizing global fertilizer supply balancing steady agricultural demand.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production capacity caps and strong green transition demand.

Diversified.note: Balanced portfolio exposure offsetting iron ore weakness with copper strength.
